exams.name: National Board Dental Examination (Joint Commission on National Dental Examinations)
exams.notes: Must pass a national board examination of the joint commission on national dental examinations or another examination accepted by commission rule; dentists must pass an examination approved by a majority of the dentist members of the dental board.
exams.jurisdiction: national (Joint Commission on National Dental Examinations)
exams.quote: Accept the national board examinations of the joint commission on national dental examinations or another examination accepted by commission rule as a licensure examination.

exams.name: Clinical Assessment
exams.notes: Applicants must successfully complete a clinical assessment for licensure.
exams.quote: Require for licensure that applicants successfully complete a clinical assessment.

required.quote: Have continuing professional development requirements as a condition for license renewal.

value: opioid prescribing continuing education for licensees who prescribed opioids during the previous licensure cycle
topical_requirements.quote: The board of medicine, board of dentistry, board of physician assistants, board of podiatry, and board of nursing shall establish rules requiring a person licensed pursuant to section 148.3, 148C.3, 149.3, or 152.6 or chapter 153 who has prescribed opioids to a patient during the previous licensure cycle to receive continuing education credits regarding the United States centers for disease control and prevention guideline for prescribing opioids for chronic pain

available.quote: The board may issue a license under this chapter without examination to an applicant who furnishes satisfactory proof that the applicant meets all of the following requirements: 1. requirements.value: License by credentials available without examination if applicant holds equivalent license from another state and has either passed a regional or national examination approved by the dental board or has been in legal practice for three consecutive years immediately prior to application.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud or deceit in procuring the license or registration or the renewal thereof.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: For fraud or deceit in procuring the license or registration or the renewal thereof to practice dentistry, dental hygiene, or dental assisting.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Guilty of willful and gross malpractice or willful and gross neglect in practice.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: For being guilty of willful and gross malpractice or willful and gross neglect in the practice of dentistry, dental hygiene, or dental assisting.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud in representation as to skill or ability.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: For fraud in representation as to skill or ability.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful or repeated violations of this chapter, subtitle, or board rules.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: For willful or repeated violations of this chapter, this subtitle, or the rules of the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining any fee by fraud or misrepresentation.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: For obtaining any fee by fraud or misrepresentation.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to pay license or registration fees as provided.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: For having failed to pay license or registration fees as provided herein.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Gross immorality or dishonorable or unprofessional conduct in practice.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: For gross immorality or dishonorable or unprofessional conduct in the practice of dentistry, dental hygiene, or dental assisting.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to maintain a reasonably satisfactory standard of competency in practice.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: For failure to maintain a reasonably satisfactory standard of competency in the practice of dentistry, dental hygiene, or dental assisting.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of a law of this state, another state, or the US, related to the practice of dentistry.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: For a violation of a law of this state, another state, or the United States, without regard to its designation as either a felony or misdemeanor, which law relates to the practice of dentistry, dental hygiene, or dental assisting.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Revocation or suspension of license or other disciplinary action by a licensing authority of another state, territory, or country.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The revocation or suspension of a license or registration to practice dentistry, dental hygiene, or dental assisting or other disciplinary action taken by a licensing authority of another state, territory, or country.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly aiding, assisting, procuring, or advising a person to unlawfully practice dentistry, dental hygiene, or dental assisting.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly aiding, assisting, procuring, or advising a person to unlawfully practice dentistry, dental hygiene, or dental assisting.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Adjudication of mental incompetence by a court of competent jurisdiction.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: For an adjudication of mental incompetence by a court of competent jurisdiction. Such adjudication shall automatically suspend a license or registration for the duration of the license or registration unless the board orders otherwise.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Inability to practice with reasonable skill and safety due to illness, drunkenness, excessive use of drugs, or mental or physical condition.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Inability to practice dentistry, dental hygiene, or dental assisting with reasonable skill and safety by reason of illness, drunkenness, or habitual or excessive use of drugs, intoxicants, narcotics, chemicals, or other types of materials or as a result of a mental or physical condition.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being a party to or assisting in any violation of any provision of this chapter.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: For being a party to or assisting in any violation of any provision of this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: For a dental hygienist, the practice of dentistry; for a dentist, permitting a dental hygienist to practice dentistry.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: For a dental hygienist, the practice of dentistry by the dental hygienist; and for a dentist, permitting the practice of dentistry by a dental hygienist by the dentist under whose supervision the dental hygienist is operating.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Receiving any rebate or other thing of value from any dental laboratory or dental technician.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Receiving any rebate, or other thing of value, directly or indirectly from any dental laboratory or dental technician.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Solicitation of professional patronage by agents known as 'cappers' or 'steerers'.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Solicitation of professional patronage by agents or persons popularly known as "cappers" or "steerers", or profiting by the acts of those representing themselves to be agents of the licensee.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Receipt of fees on the assurance that a manifestly incurable disease can be permanently cured.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Receipt of fees on the assurance that a manifestly incurable disease can be permanently cured.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Division of fees or agreeing to split fees for bringing or referring a patient without patient consent.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Division of fees or agreeing to split or divide the fees received for professional services with any person for bringing or referring a patient or assisting in the care or treatment of a patient without the consent of said patient or the patient's legal representative.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful neglect of a patient in a critical condition.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willful neglect of a patient in a critical condition.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Certificate accompanying renewal application is not in all material respects true.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A license to practice either dentistry or dental hygiene, or registration as a dental assistant, shall be revoked or suspended in the manner and upon the grounds elsewhere provided in this chapter, and also when the certificate accompanying the application of such licensee or registrant for renewal of license or registration filed with the board is not in all material respects true.

definition_quote.value: Persons who perform examination, diagnosis, treatment, and attempted correction by any medicine, appliance, surgery, or other appropriate method of any disease, condition, disorder, lesion, injury, deformity, or defect of the oral cavity and maxillofacial area, including teeth, gums, jaws, and associated structures and tissue, which methods by education, background experience, and expertise are common to the practice of dentistry.
definition_quote.quote: Persons who perform examination, diagnosis, treatment, and attempted correction by any medicine, appliance, surgery, or other appropriate method of any disease, condition, disorder, lesion, injury, deformity, or defect of the oral cavity and maxillofacial area, including teeth, gums, jaws, and associated structures and tissue, which methods by education, background experience, and expertise are common to the practice of dentistry.

methods_authorized.quote: Persons who perform examination, diagnosis, treatment, and attempted correction by any medicine, appliance, surgery, or other appropriate method of any disease, condition, disorder, lesion, injury, deformity, or defect of the oral cavity and maxillofacial area

drug_authority.value: A dentist shall have the right to prescribe and administer drugs or medicine, perform such surgical operations, administer general or local anesthetics and use such appliances as may be necessary to the proper practice of dentistry.
drug_authority.quote: A dentist shall have the right to prescribe and administer drugs or medicine, perform such surgical operations, administer general or local anesthetics and use such appliances as may be necessary to the proper practice of dentistry.

dental_hygienist_supervision_levels.quote: Such services, except educational services, shall be performed under supervision of a licensed dentist but nothing in this section shall be construed to authorize a dental hygienist to practice dentistry.

dental_office_ownership_restrictions.quote: No person owning or conducting any place where dental work of any kind is done or contracted for, shall employ or permit any unlicensed dentist to practice dentistry in said place.

opioid_prescribing_limits.quote: Any board created under this chapter that licenses a prescribing practitioner shall adopt rules under chapter 17A establishing penalties for prescribing practitioners that prescribe opioids in dosage amounts exceeding what would be prescribed by a reasonably prudent prescribing practitioner engaged in the same practice.

teledentistry_authorized.quote: The licensee performs an initial in-person or teledentistry examination of the teeth and supporting structures of the new patient prior to beginning orthodontic treatment.

hygienist_local_anesthesia_certification.quote: The board shall not adopt rules that delegate to a dental assistant the administration of local anesthesia or the removal of plaque, stain, calculus, or hard natural material except by toothbrush, floss, or rubber cup coronal polish.

restorative_function_endorsement_availab.quote: A registered dental assistant with additional education and training, as provided by the board by rule, may become certified to perform expanded functions or become qualified to participate in dental radiography.
